19._section_summary: This section discusses the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), highlighting its reliability and validity as a tool for measuring creative achievement. It notes the CAQ's good test-retest reliability, high internal consistency, accuracy in predicting laboratory creative performance, and solid convergent validity with other creativity measures. The CAQ also demonstrated good discriminant validity against IQ, indicating its separability from intelligence, and was unrelated to self-enhancement. The framework of the CAQ allows researchers to examine creative achievement within specific domains, compare individuals across different domains (e.g., arts vs. science), and study versatility.
